response.description: Teams running Windows workloads on AKS often need stronger boot-chain protection for regulated or security-sensitive environments, but Trusted Launch support has historically stopped short of Windows node pools. With Windows Server 2025, AKS will preview Trusted Launch for Windows nodes, adding Secure Boot and vTPM-backed measured boot so the underlying VMs can verify signed boot components and surface boot integrity signals. Platform teams get a more trusted Windows host baseline for Kubernetes workloads, reducing exposure to bootkits, rootkits, and low-level malware without leaving the AKS node pool model.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Windows Trusted Launch
